name: gamenet_get_status_bit_allow_maps
description: GameNet::GetStatusBitAllowMaps returns the global multiplayer allow-maps status bit set by GameNet::SetStatusBitsFromFlags.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this accessor; tier S verification is deferred to the GameNet status/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433730 shows a direct return of g_GameNetStatus_AllowMaps with no authored callees.
The native GameNet status smoke verifies SetStatusBitsFromFlags drives GetStatusBitAllowMaps for both set and cleared allow-map states.
